name: M3U Timeshift
description: Catch-up support for standard M3U sources with timeshift or tvg-rec and stream metadata propagation.
author: Dispatcharr plugin

fields.label: Enabled
fields.help_text: Enable M3U timeshift scanning and playback hooks.

fields.label: Debug mode
fields.help_text: Write extra diagnostic logs with redacted upstream URLs.

fields.label: UTC parameter name
fields.help_text: Query parameter appended to M3U catch-up URLs.

fields.label: Maximum archive days
fields.help_text: Clamp provider timeshift values to this many days.

fields.label: Scan after M3U refresh
fields.help_text: Automatically rescan standard M3U streams after refresh events.

fields.label: Pace HLS archive
fields.help_text: Limit bridged HLS catch-up output using EXTINF durations and the HLS archive speed setting. Disable to send as fast as the source and client allow.

fields.label: HLS archive speed
fields.help_text: Seconds of video sent per real second during the initial burst when pacing is enabled. Default 5; use 1 for real-time delivery. Applies to new playback requests.

fields.label: HLS initial burst duration (seconds)
fields.help_text: Seconds of video sent at HLS archive speed before returning to 1x. Default 60; 0 means 1x from the start. Each new playback request, including a timestamp seek, gets a fresh budget.

actions.label: Scan M3U timeshift streams
actions.description: Update catch-up flags from standard M3U timeshift or tvg-rec attributes.

actions.label: Scan after M3U refresh
actions.description: Update M3U timeshift flags after an M3U refresh.

actions.label: Stop
actions.description: Disable plugin hooks in this process.
